title: Questor
summary: QUES'TOR, noun [Latin quaestor. See Quest and Query.] In Roman antiquity, an officer who had the management of the public treasure; the receiver of taxes, tribute, etc.

inlines.v: QUES'TOR, noun [Latin quaestor. See Quest and Query.] In Roman antiquity, an officer who had the management of the public treasure; the receiver of taxes, tribute, etc.
